map.：H 从 3 增到 4，Q 增约 1.54 倍（H^1.5），高水位泄量陡增。: : H increases from 3 to 4, Q increases about 1.54 times (H^1.5), discharge rises sharply at high water.
map.下游水位低于坎顶为自由（用 H），淹没时受下游顶托泄量降。: Free outflow when downstream water level is below the crest (use H); when submerged, backwater support from downstream reduces discharge.
